about: The places an agent's tool call may name (Sprint 28h, D20). This file is the person's: jawata writes it once, when none exists, and never overwrites it. ${workspace} is the folders of the workspace the calling session works in, ${home} is your home folder, ${temp} is the machine's scratch folder. A place on neither list is refused; a place on "deny" is refused even inside an allowed one. Nothing is read from a name: a file called credentials.json is allowed here unless you list it. Add a folder to "allow" to let agents work there; add a path to "deny" to take it away. A damaged or missing file refuses every place a call names.
